Reranking where Fireworks lists the scored documents under data

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.rerank({ documents: ["The weather is sunny today.", "Deep learning uses neural networks.", "Machine learning is a subset of AI."], model: "fireworks_ai/rerank-x", query: "What is machine learning?" });
  console.log(result.results);
  console.log(result.results[0].relevanceScore);
}

void main();
```
